stories.title: ISOMITIT
stories.text:
Isomitit kō otēpto nē punēy chiito agetōgōl ēn kāsārwēēk alak ēn sopēēnyuwaan. Imuuchēy konaam isomitit kōsērpēn ōtkō ōwiit. Yā-iitu kiit kaigaa-ey keey chiito ēn katyaat nē siirēy āroo-ēk o-ēēny.
Chaang' tuguuk chē ōpu isomitit. Imuuchēy koonaamey ng'ālyoot nē katiritiit, kōyuu ingōpētyo rwoonik, onoon kō iyoon katunumak chiito. Kiit age nē ōpu isomitit kō pōōgitēēgoop rootiik onoon kō chēpo kērichēēk.
Kiit nē itooy chiito ingōwālu ng'aleek kōmuuchēy kōōpoor kōlē tinyēy isomitit. Imuuchēy konyitak onoon kōōpoor otēpto nē mānenyiin. Chiito nē tin isomitit, kōtunumaksēy is kosaagiit.
Chiito nē tin isomitit kōsyēnu  iskō materektaat mētit. Kāsēy kōgomēw is kōpētyo  rwoonik onoon  kōruu ōtkō.
Chiito nē tinyēy isomitit kō usoot kōtēēn kay, iskō mēēy kōmāgēēn kēy  koyay kiit nē   kiichāmēy koyay.
Chiito nē isomitaat kōōmuuchēy kolugey keey is  koriirtaa-ey keey ēn tuguuk chē kayayak koya. Chiito nē isomitaat kōchāmēy kōōtepiēy ineegeey kōtēēn kay  is kopwaat kōlē kaygay  mee-eet.
Kō aynyōōn, nee ne maktaat iyay iyoon  iisomitaat, onoon iyoon itinyē chorweet onoon kō chiitoop latyeeng'uung' nē toogu kōlē tinyēy isomitit?

Asa kiimuuchey kēētēēr isomiitit komanam chiito?
Kiit ne taay  kō kee-am āmiitwoogik chē siing'ōō-ēēn chē iuyuuyēy pōōrwēk. Kiit kagiam āmiitwoogik chē maktaat  kēēgosē kōsiing'ōōy is kotereekta keey mētōwēēkchook. Āmitwoogiik chē  kii-āmēy  kō chē tēēchēy pōōrwēk  chē yuu maa-eeniik, samageenik,injuguuk ak ingwēēk chē nyāliilēēn. Tuguuk alak chē tēēchēy pōōrto /kēēsigēēn  marakweek, mologeenik ak mwaanik.
Po koomonuutyēt kiinin keey si kōsiing'ō-iit pōōrto, is koterekta keey mētit. Keepeendaat ēn iyē indēē kōriisto nē siing'ōōy, kēēyāyiis ēn imbareet, marareet ak pirēētoop imbireet ak loogōōk kō siing'ōōy ēn pōōrto.
Mā iyuutyē iyee pēēk che chaang' iyoon  iininii pōōrto  ēn pēētuut kōtēēn ki-oon. Ma iyee rootiik onoon kō tawoosyek chē kipōōgitēēn.
Cheeng' iyē iimuung'ē ēēn saang' is iitolēēn ki-eet. Ipwaat kiit nē  chāmdooyiin Tōrōōrēt.    Ingen  tuguuk

stories.title: TYPŌYT
stories.text:
Kiintē koymuutik chē yuu kiyoon tōtoonik alak, kōyookto :sirkaliit konēētiintētoop myēyntaap pōōrto. Kiineet Pwaari piik chē kiimochēy konay kēy ōpu miyoni, ak kēy kiyoyēy si komanam chiito.
Kooyan Pwaari kōnyō tōtēētoop akut Mōōsi.Kiin kokas Pwaari kēy kiimyontooy piik komwa kōlē, "Iporē yuu taypōyt".
Ōw typōyt ēēn kiyeet nē purkēy, is kōmuuchēy kotar piik. Ōpu kuutyet nē kikuurēēn "Salmonella Typhi".
Imuuchēy kotar araaweet onoon kōsiir si kōsop chiito, is kōmuuchēy kōyēēychi kiit maay riipkeey.
Kiiteep piikoop tōtonoon kōlē, "Nee nē itooy inkōnomēy piik taypōyt?".
Kōmwoochi Pwaari kōlēēnchi, "Sichēy :piik kuutyani kiit kaye onoon kowam omtit nē kaynaamta kuutichaan chiito nē tin kōrōōwoon. Imuuchēy konaamtakeey piik ēēn koriik chē kiisēsēēnkeey chē murēēn, ak kiit maach iwuun ēwuunēk piik kōsing'ōōy kō kapa kooseeskeey.
Maktaat kētēēkyi korchoon kiisēsēēnkeey iyē lōōw ēēn iyē kiromēēn pēēk. Iyoo pēēk chē kiyēēy ot kokuut." Kong'at kōlē, piik chē tin typōyt kō mamaktaat konam onoon kooyo omtit.
Ōpēy kalyang'ik simto ēēn kēyēkyuwaak. Kō maktaat aynyōōn iiker omtit komanam kalyaang'ik.Ker ng'wēnēēt ak kurkeet nēpo koon kiisēsēēnkeey, is ing'uuy saraktiit ēēn pēyuung'uung'.

Sing'ōōy iikan iyoo inkwēēk kōtōōmo iiyam.

Iwuunēēn ēwuunēk sopuniit ak pēēk chē tiliilēēn kōtōōmo iyoo omtit
"Nee nē yoyey chiito si kōmyēēyt ēēn typōyt?"

Kōpoorchi :chichoon po myēyntoop pōōrto piikoop tōtonoon kēy kiinētēēn piik, koneet kōlēēnchi, "Maktaat iyee pēēk che chaang' onoon kō lukumeekoop ng'onoyēēk." Kiit ko-iintēn sawumuusyek onoon kō sawumuusyek chē ng'ooti omtit kōyoychin pōōrto. Kō muchēlēēk ak ng'onoyēēk chē inkoop koruryo kō tin aasisiikyet ēēn pōōrto kōkēny.Saayit ake kō toorēti kērichēēk pōōrto kōyēētunēy myonwookik.

Ya kōmyēēy inkonam lokōōk chē sērpēnēēn taypōyt. Kiit kaynay iilē tin laakwa kuutikaap typōyt, immuti takitaari onoon kō chiitoop myēyntoop pōōrto.

bilingualReadings.title: Musar
bilingualReadings.text:
Kikichopkei Zama kuwo sukul karon.

Mi kichobe aboo musarek ab karon.

Kimwa Zama kile, "Nget iyoo kichob musar cho koromen kisir aboo!"

Torete musar Zama mu sukul simaam ruba.

Ochu musarek kikururyo.

Rong'u aboo cheko mu chomnyot nyo wou.

Kimwa Zama kile, "Aboo, Bere chii tikimeche musarechu sukaru keny."

Kipkaat Zama mi metinyi kile, "Anyinyen musarekab iyoo kisir chobo aboo."

Kisom Zama sukaru kile "Aboo kono sukaruk atesyi musarek amu mayem."

Mi kukochinii aboto Zama sukaruk kamining kitesyi musarekchi.

"Woo! Aboo! Ketesyi chumbi musarekchu!"

Kiteb Zama abonyii kile "Chone ayu iyoo kaa keny."
bilingualReadings.english:
Zama is getting ready for school.

Dad is cooking porridge for breakfast.

"Mom makes the best porridge!" says Zama.

Porridge gives Zama energy for school.

The porridge is ready.

Dad pours the milk, with love.

"Dad, I think this porridge needs more sugar," says Zama.

"Mom's porridge tastes much better than Dad's porridge," thinks Zama.

"Dad, please can I have more sugar?" asks Zama.

Dad gives Zama more sugar.

"Wu! Dad! You put salt on my porridge!"

"Dad, when will Mom be home?" asks Zama.

One afternoon, Saboo was playing alone in the garden “Mother can I have a small puppy?”

“No,” said mother.

“A very small puppy?”

asked Saboo.

“No,” said mother.

Saboo kicked a stone, which rolled near a tree. The tree trunk had fur. He touched it and looked up, up, and right up. He saw two eyes looking down at him.

“Hello! Who are you?” asked a surprised Saboo.

“Hello yourself, I am a giraffe. My name is Jojo. I can play with you. If you climb up on to my back, I will take you for a ride.”

Saboo climbed up and away they went down the road, up the hill, and into town.

Saboo shouted happily,

“Jojo turn right, now left, and again right,” till they came to his friend Munni's house.

bilingualReadings.title: Makasta Ne Amei Rubet
bilingualReadings.text:
Kitun ko kimi makasta ne kiame rubet.

Kicheng' amitwokik mutyo ko sisei.

Atya...

Rrr! Kiryach makasta.

Kibaibait amu kimatokoame rubet.

Agoi koam rubet kogeny.
bilingualReadings.english:
I am Subaami. This is my mother- Swetha.

My father's name is Sujan. My brother's name is Shreyas.

All our names begin with S!

Shreyas and I, made the picture on the wall.

Today Amma has worn a saree that is just the colour of the sun in the picture.

It looks so pretty with orange and red and yellow.

Amma goes to office. She reads a lot. She makes very nice food.

Hmmmmm...smells so good!

I think she is making sweet corn curry.

We have a pet cat.

Her name also begins with S- Sweety.

My grandma lives with us.

She tells me stories, I read my story books to her.

And her name? Sundaravalli.

And S...yes, we are one sweet happy family!

Once there was a very hungry crocodile.

He searched for food slowly and quietly. And then...

POW!!! The crocodile strikes!

After that he is no longer hungry, and he is happy.

Until he gets hungry again.
